# Four-sou candidate and independent heldout

The added reference `templates/client/4s__ff7_friend.png` is an unmodified 92×151 crop at (792,921) from the CPU friend-match frame with SHA-256 `b87ba0326c6544d50dc0c1b6647f16ad19c43654a9d94a6c9cdb8f004191cebf`. The heldout `4s-b388-heldout.png` is an unmodified 92×151 crop at (1486,921) from a later separate CPU friend-match frame with SHA-256 `074a7a8fe9bdf76df19b501d1521b7555b0e05c0b30c44dac26c9438105640e4`. Both show 4s by direct visual inspection. Their crop hashes differ, and neither crop contains names, avatars or account details.

A separate e48 match's 4s draw produced a crop byte-identical to the b388 heldout and was deliberately excluded as a training reference. The heldout test measures classification only; it does not certify the full hand, turn, legal move, or gameplay result. Installation is explicit and only between matches.
